qualification_scripts.arm-wrap.py:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shlex,os,subprocess
root=Path('/work/extended/arm-release');rows=[]
for folder in [root,root/'benchmarks']:
 for p in sorted(folder.glob('gig_*')):
  if not p.is_file():continue
  b=p.read_bytes()
  if b[:4]!=b'\x7fELF':continue
  assert int.from_bytes(b[18:20],'little')==183,p
  target=p.with_name(p.name+'.aarch64-elf');assert not target.exists();p.rename(target)
  p.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nexec /usr/bin/qemu-aarch64 -L /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu '+shlex.quote(str(target))+' "$@"\n');p.chmod(0o755)
  rows.append({'program':str(p),'elf':str(target),'elf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'wrapper_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'ELF_machine':183})
assert len(rows)>20
Path('/work/extended/arm-wrappers.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print('Wrapped',len(rows),'AArch64 ELFs; no binfmt registration or native claim')
